title: Wash your Bowl
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating awareness and detachment from our thoughts, emotions, and desires. By paying attention to our inner lives and letting go of distractions, we can find peace and contentment in the present moment. This involves recognizing that our minds are not a single entity, but rather a complex web of sensations and experiences that can be explored and understood through mindfulness and contemplation.
topics: acceptance and appreciation of life's imperfection.
